summary: Resolves the constructor team with the highest championship-points score. Allocates an 8-byte [name, score] object via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper (name=0, score=-1), then loops over the 14 constructor team name strings (Arrows, BAR/off_5C25E0, Renault, Ferrari, Jaguar, Jordan, McLaren, Minardi, Prost, Sauber, Williams, Toyota, Benetton, Stewart). For each team the name is staged through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and scored with ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1). A candidate beats the current best when its score is higher and (if a1 is non-null) it passes the sub_566810 filter; the best name is committed via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) and its score saved. If a2 is non-zero, returns the [name, score] object immediately; otherwise a second identical 14-team pass detects ties: if any team's score equals the stored best, returns 0. Falls through to return the object when no tie is found.

local_names.v4: allocated char*[2] output object (v10); [0] best-name pointer, [1] best score as char* bit pattern
local_names.v8: stored best-name pointer, or &byte_5EA438 when the stored pointer is null

operations.description: v4 = OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8); allocate the 8-byte char*[2] output object.
If allocation failed, v10 = 0; otherwise v10 = v4.

First pass: do/while v5 in 0..13, dispatch via jump table jpt_41F385; each case stages the corresponding constructor name (aArrows, off_5C25E0, aRenault, aFerrari, aJaguar, aJordan, aMclaren, aMinardi, aProst, aSauber, aWilliams, aToyota, aBenetton, aStewart) through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
v6 = ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1); compute the championship-points score of the team currently staged in byte_5EA438.
If v11 < v6 AND (a1 is null OR sub_566810(&byte_5EA438, a1) returns false), the candidate is the new best: commit its name via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(&byte_5EA438) and set v11 = v6.
If a2 is non-zero, return v10 immediately after the first pass (no tie-check).
Second pass (only when a2 == 0): infinite loop dispatching v7 0..13 via jump table jpt_41F465, staging each constructor name through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc exactly as the first pass.

Tie detection per candidate: v8 = *v10 (stored best name), or &byte_5EA438 when the stored pointer is null; if sub_566810(v8, &byte_5EA438) is false (names equal) AND v11 == ChampionshipPointsAccumulator(&byte_5EA438, -1), return 0 (another team ties the best score).
After all 14 second-pass teams, return v10 (the [name, score] object of the highest-scoring team).
